Sticky honey soy wings with a ranch dip.How to make it1kg chicken wings, tips off and jointed3 tbsp honey3 tbsp soy sauce2 garlic cloves, crushed1 tsp smoked paprika125g sour cream2 tbsp whole-egg mayonnaise1 tbsp chives, chopped1 tsp lemon juiceToss the wings with the honey, soy, garlic and paprika.Spread on a lined tray and bake at 200°C, turning once, until sticky and dark.Stir the sour cream, mayo, chives and lemon juice together for the dip.Share-a-croissant ham and cheese croissantsThe crew shares a croissant without Emmet. Warm croissants with leg ham, gruyere and Dijon.How to make it4 large butter croissants150g shaved leg ham100g gruyere, grated2 tbsp Dijon mustard20g butter, meltedSplit the croissants and spread the insides with mustard.Fill with the ham and most of the cheese.Brush the tops with butter, scatter over the rest of the cheese and bake at 180°C until melted and crisp.Cut in half and serve warm.Octan cheese and crackersOctan makes everything, even the dairy products.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsGiant sausages with fried onionsGiant sausages and Emmet left behind. Thick pork sausages in buttered rolls with fried onions.How to make it4 thick pork sausages4 long crusty rolls2 brown onions, thinly sliced30g butter4 tbsp tomato sauce4 tbsp American mustardFry the onions slowly in half the butter until soft and golden.Grill the sausages, turning, until browned and cooked through.Split and butter the rolls.Tuck in the sausages and top with onions, sauce and mustard.Taco Tuesday beef tacosThe Kragle is set for Taco Tuesday. Spiced beef, tomato salsa, cheese and lime crema.How to make it600g beef mince1 brown onion, diced2 tsp ground cumin2 tsp sweet paprika2 tbsp tomato paste12 small flour tortillas3 tomatoes, diced1 cup coriander, chopped100g cheddar, grated125g sour cream2 limes1/4 iceberg lettuce, shreddedBrown the mince and onion, then stir in the cumin, paprika and tomato paste with a splash of water and simmer until thick.Mix the tomatoes and coriander with a squeeze of lime for the salsa.Stir the sour cream with the zest and juice of the other lime.Warm the tortillas in a dry pan.Fill with lettuce, beef, salsa, cheese and crema.SweetsCloud Cuckoo Land rainbow sundaesNo rules in Cloud Cuckoo Land.
